title: Craft XST
description: 高版本纯净空岛 & 单方块空岛公益服，提供最优质的体验。A Minecraft Skyblock & OneBlock server, offering the best possible experience. EaglerCraft is now supported!
body:
## History 📜

**Craft XST** first launched in February 2021 with version 1.16.5, maintaining over 20 daily active players. After multiple version upgrades and world resets, the peak concurrent player count reached more than 50. In 2024, it was renamed to ~~Isles~~.

In 2026, it restarted under the Craft XST name, positioning itself as a Skyblock survival server.

**Craft XST** 于 2021 年 2 月首次开服，版本号为 1.16.5，当时每日活跃玩家超过 20 人。经过多次版本升级和世界重置后，最高同时在线玩家数达到 50 多人。2024 年，该服务器更名为 ~~Isles~~。

2026 年，该服务器以 Craft XST 之名重新启动，定位为 Skyblock 生存服务器。

## Server Info ⭐

- Java: `craft.xst.fan` (Support 1.8.x-26.2.x)
- Eagler: `wss://craft.xst.fan` (Support 1.8.8/1.12.2)
- QQ Group: `867393658`

## What We Offer ✨

### Cross-Version Support

We currently support all the versions listed on the right, which have been thoroughly tested by our management team. In addition, we also support EagleCraft; you can use the corresponding client to join the server.

我们目前支持右侧列出的所有版本，这些版本均已由我们的管理团队进行了全面测试。此外，我们还支持 EagleCraft；您可以使用相应的客户端连接到服务器。

### QOL features 🌲

We offers a comprehensive suite of quality-of-life features designed to make your Skyblock journey smoother and more enjoyable.

These features are continuously refined based on player feedback, ensuring that your experience on Craft XST remains as frictionless and rewarding as possible.

我们提供了一套全面的生活质量功能，旨在让您的 Skyblock 之旅更加顺畅、更加愉快。

### Data safty

We prioritize safety and convenience, offering reliable ways to protect your progress and recover from mishaps.

Regular automated backups run silently in the background, ensuring that even in the rare event of a hardware or software failure, we can restore your world to a recent state with minimal disruption. These backups are stored redundantly across multiple locations for added reliability.

我们以安全与便捷为首要原则，提供可靠的方式来保护您的游戏进度，并在意外发生时帮助您恢复数据。

系统会定期在后台静默执行自动备份，确保即使在极少数硬件或软件故障的情况下，我们也能将您的游戏世界恢复到最近的状态，同时将中断影响降至最低。这些备份会跨多个地点进行冗余存储，以进一步提高可靠性。

### Stable Network ⚡

Our server network is powered by Velocity Proxy, which is designed to provide smooth connections, efficient routing, and an overall better multiplayer experience.

We optimize the gaming experience for players worldwide by leveraging a CDN to deliver content from the nearest location.

我们的服务器网络由 Velocity Proxy 提供支持，并通过 CDN 就近接入来优化全球玩家的游戏体验。
